newsitem.title: FRANCE: SOCCER-FRANCE CALL UP VIEIRA FOR NETHERLANDS' MATCH.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-FRANCE CALL UP VIEIRA FOR NETHERLANDS' MATCH.

text.p: France coach Aime Jacquet continued to experiment with the national team on Thursday by calling up Arsenal's Patrick Vieira for next Wednesday's home friendly against the Netherlands.

"He's an element for the future. My objective in this key year is to enlarge my group while leaning on the solid base we have built," Jacquet said after naming his 18-man squad for the match at the Parc des Princes.
Former Cannes and AC Milan midfielder Vieira has shone in the English premier league this season under the tutelage of Arsenal's French manager Arsene Wenger.
Bordeaux's Ibrahim Ba, a new recruit for the previous match away to Portugal last month, is retained after a promising debut which included a brilliant second goal in a 2-0 victory.

But Internazionale's Youri Djorkaeff, who has been allowed to play for his club in their Italian Cup semifinal second leg at Napoli on the same night, will miss a France match for the first time in almost a year.
"I'm not crazy," Jacquet said. "There are international rules and I respect them. I don't want to get angry with the directors of big clubs a year from the World Cup."
World body FIFA's rules state that clubs are obliged to release players for seven internationals in a year.
Jacquet also recalled two exiled defenders, AS Roma's Vincent Candela and Bixente Lizarazu of Athletic Bilbao, who last played in the 4-0 home win over Mexico before a serious injury.
"He is on the up again and it's important that he comes back quickly into the group after being badly injured," Jacquet said.

Despite widespread clamour for a place in the squad for Strasbourg's David Zitelli -- 16 league goals and five in the League Cup -- Jacquet made no changes among the forwards with another chance for AC Milan's Christophe Dugarry to stake a claim to the role of striker.
France's Euro 96 goalkeeper Bernard Lama returns to the squad for the first time since a knee injury in September.
It remains to be seen whether Jacquet will pick Monaco's Fabien Barthez, first choice for the last three games after being Lama's reserve for a long period.
Goalkeepers - Fabien Barthez (Monaco), Bernard Lama (Paris St Germain).
Defenders - Laurent Blanc (Barcelone), Marcel Desailly (AC Milan), Vincent Candela (AS Roma), Bixente Lizarazu (Athletic Bilbao), Patrick Blondeau (Monaco), Lilian Thuram (Parma).
Midfielders - Didier Deschamps (Juventus), Christian Karembeu, Pierre Laigle (both Sampdoria), Bruno N'Gotty (PSG), Patrick Vieira (Arsenal).
Forwards - Zinedine Zidane (Juventus), Ibrahim Ba (Bordeaux), Christophe Dugarry (AC Milan), Patrice Loko (PSG), Robert Pires (Metz).
